newsitem.title: UK: LME aluminium edges down in late trading.
newsitem.headline: LME aluminium edges down in late trading.

text.p: LME aluminium dipped in late inter-office trading, extending the day's moderate losses.
At 1800 GMT, three months aluminium was indicated at $1,605/07, down from a $1,615 kerb close, which itself represented an $8 loss.
Support should be seen around the 10-day moving average at $1,604, but if that fails to hold, next support is pegged at the June 3 low of $1,575 and then $1,540, analysts said.
Copper was little changed, indicated at $2,577/80 versus a kerb close of $2,580 while nickel was slightly weaker at $7,150/70 compared to $7,195.
